hooks.name: on-legacy-drop
hooks.description: When a legacy source file is saved or dropped under samples/ (including the notch drop folder samples/dropped/), run the static autopsy and write its EARS requirements next to the specs so Kiro can pick them up.

action.command: in=$(cat); echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) on-legacy-drop stdin=$(printf %s "$in" | tr -d "\n" | head -c 500)" >> benchmarks/hook-firings.log; f=$(printf %s "$in" | grep -oE '[^"]*\.(cob|ch8)' | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] && cargo run --quiet --release --bin necro-cli -- autopsy "$f" --requirements > ".kiro/specs/autopsy-$(basename "${f%.*}").md"; true
